title: 第9章 萧灵汐的仙法第10章 莫欺少年穷
slug: 付费才能修仙我的宗门全免费
content_zh:
进入仙法阁的萧灵汐，如同一只好奇的小猫，左顾右盼。
当她看见满房间飘来飘去的仙法卷轴时，当即就震惊了。
与诸葛风不一样，她出身大家族，见识广了解的多。
仙法越多，品质越好，越能体现一个宗门的实力！
灵霄宗够强了吧？
可其仙法的数量，也不超过一百本！
可眼前这仙法阁内，光是仙法卷轴，就绝对超过了万数！！
这哪里是什么仙法阁，完全就像是一座珍贵的宝库啊！
萧灵汐激动的娇躯都有点颤抖，这么多仙法，她完全不知道该选什么。
“请将手放在面前的石台上。”
似乎是看出萧灵汐不知道如何选择，仙法阁的守灵出声了。
“谁......谁在说话？”
如之前诸葛风一样，萧灵汐也是吓了一大跳，环顾四周。
“我是仙法阁的守灵，不必害怕。”
守灵的声音响起：“按照宗门规矩，每个新加入我们天道宗的弟子，都可以挑选一部仙法。”
“如果你想自己选择，可以随意选一个仙法卷轴，如果要我为你挑选，请将手放在前面的石碑上。”
“守灵？传说中的神器之灵？”萧灵汐再次傻眼。
在大陆上，拥有器灵的神器，那绝对属于至强的存在！
而拥有器灵的强者，那也绝对是大陆的顶尖强者！
至少，灵霄宗她没有听说过有什么器灵的存在！

“师尊没有骗我，他或许真的不惧怕灵霄宗！”
萧灵汐心里暗忖，随后深吸口气，压下心头的震撼，平复了心情后，这才小心翼翼的朝着石台走去。
她将手放在了石柱之上。
嗡——
一阵轻颤，石台上亮起光芒，一个卷轴缓缓浮现，同时，守灵的声音再次响起。
“你性格活跃，心性跳脱，此乃《玉女心经?炼气篇》，可结合你的体质拥有更强的修炼效果。”
“玉女心经？诸葛师兄也是修炼的这个？不不不，这听名字就是适合女人修炼。”
萧灵汐嘀咕着，拿起卷轴之后，又询问道：“守灵前辈，这玉女心经是天道宗最强的仙法吗？”
“修炼这个可以做到一个时辰一百次周天循环吗？”
萧灵汐期待的问道，她还是忘不了一百次啊一百次。
“没有最强的仙法，只有最合适的仙法，若是一味追求最强，而修炼不适合的仙法，又能走多远？”
content_en:
Xiao Lingxi, who entered the Immortal Law Pavilion, looked around like a curious kitten.
When she saw the fairy scrolls floating around the room, she was immediately shocked.
Unlike Zhuge Feng, she comes from a big family and has a lot of experience and understanding.
The more immortal magic there are, the better the quality, and the more it can reflect the strength of a sect!
Is Lingxiao Sect strong enough?
But the number of its immortal spells does not exceed one hundred!
But in the Immortal Magic Pavilion in front of me, there are definitely more than ten thousand Immortal Magic Scrolls alone! !
What kind of Immortal Magic Pavilion is this? It’s like a precious treasure house!
Xiao Lingxi's delicate body was trembling with excitement. There were so many immortal techniques, and she had no idea what to choose.
"Please place your hands on the stone platform in front of you."
Seemingly sensing that Xiao Lingxi didn't know how to choose, the guardian of the Immortal Law Pavilion spoke up.
"Who... who's talking?"
Just like Zhuge Feng before, Xiao Lingxi was also startled and looked around.
"I am the guardian of the Immortal Law Pavilion, there is no need to be afraid."
The guard's voice sounded: "According to the sect's rules, every new disciple who joins our Tiandao Sect can choose an immortal method."
"If you want to choose it yourself, you can choose an immortal scroll at will. If you want me to choose it for you, please put your hand on the stone tablet in front of you."
"Watching the spirit? The spirit of the legendary artifact?" Xiao Lingxi was dumbfounded again.
On the mainland, if you have an artifact with a spirit, you are definitely the most powerful being!
And the strong ones with weapon spirits are definitely the top strong ones in the mainland!
At least, she has never heard of the existence of any weapon spirits in Lingxiao Sect!
"Master didn't lie to me. Maybe he really isn't afraid of Lingxiao Sect!"
Xiao Lingxi thought to herself, then took a deep breath, suppressed the shock in her heart, calmed down, and then cautiously walked towards the stone platform.
She placed her hand on the stone pillar.
Buzz——
There was a slight tremor, the stone platform lit up with light, a scroll slowly emerged, and at the same time, the voice of the vigil sounded again.
"You have an active personality and an out-of-the-box mentality. This is the "Jade Girl's Heart Sutra: Qi Refining Chapter", which can be combined with your physique to have a stronger cultivation effect."
"The Jade Girl Heart Sutra? Senior Brother Zhuge also practices this? No, no, no, the name suggests it is suitable for women to practice."
Xiao Lingxi muttered, and after picking up the scroll, she asked again: "Senior Shou Ling, is this Jade Girl's Heart Sutra the strongest immortal method in Tiandao Sect?"
"Can you practice this to cycle through the sky a hundred times in one hour?"
Xiao Lingxi asked expectantly. She still couldn't forget it a hundred times.
"There is no strongest immortal method, only the most suitable immortal method. If you blindly pursue the strongest and practice unsuitable immortal methods, how far can you go?"
